dataList.content:
<color=#293b95>Memory sloshes within a tin bucket bearing a label.</color>
<color=#293b95>记忆，被贴上标签，收纳进了某个金属罐头。</color>

<color=#293b95>Experience dissolves into the stinging aftertaste that lingers on someone's tongue.</color>
<color=#293b95>经验，作为刺痛某人舌尖的滋味，融化其中。</color>

<color=#293b95>I hammer them into packages, obeying the instructions nailed to the wall.</color>
<color=#293b95>我遵从钉在墙上的指示，一边敲下铁锤将它们包装，</color>

<color=#293b95>My gaze faces the consistent sway of the liquid in the container.</color>
<color=#293b95>一边注视着容器中液体均匀摇晃的模样。</color>

<color=#293b95>What, in this life, could be the proof of "me"?</color>
<color=#293b95>在这人生中，“我”要通过什么得以证明。</color>

<color=#293b95>Memory? Experience?</color>
<color=#293b95>记忆，还是经验呢。</color>

<color=#293b95>And if neither...</color>
<color=#293b95>如果二者都不是……</color>

Yet another peculiar question, I see.
你这次也提出了一个奇怪的问题。
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles, Past
过去，梅菲斯托费勒斯 内部

dataList.content:
Has a single mission ever gone precisely as you expected, Dante? Why should this one be any different?
就和之前的每一次任务一样，这次的任务也不会有任何一件事如预想般顺利，但丁。

You have a point...
的确如此。
But would it have killed you to at least give us some kind of clue, Vergilius? 但是，维吉里乌斯。至少这种程度，你本来还是可以告诉我的吧。

One might come to wonder why the company keeps throwing its employees into risky situations without letting them in on all available information... Ah, I can practically hear the complaints lodged in the tick-tocks of your winding clockwork.
公司为什么不把所有的情报都提供给我们，只是一味把我们往死路上推……哎呀，好像听见了那给时钟上紧发条的不满声音呢。

Like it or not, this is how a bus operates, Dante:
不过巴士本来不就是这样的吗，但丁。

Transporting its passengers from station to station, but not to their destinations. That last part is the responsibility of each passenger.
即便它愿意将你送到站点，最后这段通往目的地的路程，也终究只能由乘客自己走完。

*sigh* The ticking of your clockwork is quickening indignantly—very well, I'll dispense with the overwrought metaphors now.
哈，听起来发条声越来越快了，玩笑的比喻就到此为止吧。

If I'm to put it more plainly...
不过，再补充一句……

... The company has already taken into account all constants and variables surrounding the Golden Boughs, yes. Theoretically, should everything go according to plan, you could simply walk in and grab the Golden Bough... But there would be no point to it.
公司确实已经将观测到的所有变量与常数都纳入了考量，但直接将那之中的金枝拾起是没有意义的，但丁。

Try to question yourself why the company forwent the option of choosing a team of professionals who are less prone to... shenanigans.
如果那样就足够了，公司一开始就会组建一支能力出众且沉默寡言的搜寻队伍。

Quiet bus? No fun for Charon.
安静的巴士。卡戎觉得无聊。

This much, however, I can tell you:
不过这句话我还是可以告诉你的。

Sinner #5... was never meant to return to this District.
5号罪人……原本不该再回到这里。

Which means that everything here that is to transpire was, from the very beginning...
所以这次即将发生的一切，也从一开始就……

... entirely beyond prediction.
全都是无法预料的事。

Vergilius tends to be cryptic and indirect anyway,
因为他说的话大多意味深长，并不直白。

so I didn't think much of it this time as well.
我这次本来也打算把他那番补充当作耳旁风。

If by "beyond prediction" he meant something that might get the Sinners killed, that wasn't anything new. It was an everyday occurrence at this point, and I do have the ability to rewind them back to life, after all.
预料之外的罪人的死亡，如今早已成了日常，而我又拥有将其回溯的能力。

... As always.
一如往常……仅此而已。

But at the time, never in my wildest dreams did I imagine that...
但即便如此，我也没想到自己竟然会和罪人们一同经历回溯……

... I would be rewound alongside the Sinners as well.
那时的我完全无从知晓。

<Did you know this would happen, Meursault?!>
<你知道会这样吗，默尔索？！>

Only after hearing the feeble question leave my proverbial mouth does Meursault turn my way.
面对这无力的质问，默尔索平淡地点了点头。

I did, Manager.
是的。经理。

As usual, his reply comes brief without a moment's delay.
立刻做出了简洁的回答。

Not the slightest sign of surprise at his arrest. Not so much as a token excuse.
没有丝毫慌乱的神色，甚至连一句敷衍的辩解都没有。

And I have no choice but to admit it—this is who he is. Always has been.
是啊，他就是这样的罪人……默尔索。

In the absence of a reasonably justifiable cause, such as a contract, engaging in battle with the City's corporate entities is strongly discouraged.
除非有委托等合理原因，否则应该尽一切可能避免无端的战斗。

Yeah?! And we're just supposed to twiddle our thumbs while they drag him away?!
我知道！但是那家伙要被带走了啊！！！

S-so where are ya taking him?
你、你们要去哪儿？

A retrial will be scheduled for the execution of the exile's sentence.
预计将进行审判，重新决定对已驱逐人员的判决。

<Guys, just... just let's all calm down first.>
<大家先冷静……>

<... Can someone ask them to explain in more detail? We need to know what exactly is going on with Meursault's trial and exile order.>
<……问问这些人，那个审判到底是怎么回事，还有他们说的驱逐令又是什么意思。>

Uh... Hang on... I don't even know where I'd begin to ask...
那个……等一下……怎么说呢……这就是语塞的感觉吗，真是的……

We will now take him into custody. Please submit a formal declaration of negotiation rights at a later date should you have any objections.
立即执行。若有异议请之后提请交涉……

Ezra, who at least had some knowledge of N Corp., stepped forward while Gregor was still ransacking his brain to find the appropriate words to ask about Meursault's trial.
在格里高尔斟酌措辞的时候，还是由对N公司多少有所了解的以斯拉出面了。
No, we're not objecting to anything yet... It's just that we're completely in the dark about what's going on here. 不是说有什么问题……只是我们完全没搞懂这到底是怎么回事。

Did the man himself tell you nothing?
……当事人什么都没告诉你们吗？

For the first time, a look of puzzlement flickered across the dispassionate countenance of the N Corp. employee.
N公司员工的脸上这才露出了一丝疑惑。

Well? Did he?
你们，有听他说过吗？

No. Nothing at all—I don't even recall him hinting at it.
完全没有，一丁点都没听说过。

To our regret... Miss Ishmael speaks true.
遗憾的是……的确如此……

The suspect, Meursault, disobeyed the court's permanent exile order and remained in N Corp.'s District without authorization.
嫌疑人默尔索。尽管目前永久驱逐令已经生效，却仍涉嫌非法滞留于N公司。

Annex 3 of the Eviction Regulations permits a stay of up to 6 hours to account for the possibility of transit en route to other Districts...
根据特别条款第3条，若是为前往其他区域而临时滞留，可获准最长6小时的宽限期，

But 6 hours have already passed, and we have concluded that the purpose of the suspect's visit is not a transit stay. Does the defendant have any objections regarding this?
但现在已经超过了6小时……经确认，我们判断此次进入并非临时滞留。被告对这一判断有异议吗？

None.
没有异议。

... Wait. How did his status suddenly change from "suspect" to "defendant"?
……等等，刚刚不还是嫌疑人吗？怎么转眼就变成被告了？

Because the indictment has been filed as we spoke.
因为就在说话的这段时间里，公诉程序已经结束了。

Outis, who was glaring at Meursault, looked just one breath away from roaring a stream of reprimands that would probably begin with "Imbecile! Couldn't you have forewarned us?!" But, somehow, she managed to hold it in.
奥提斯脸上简直就是一副马上要脱口而出“你这家伙到底……！”的表情，却似乎硬生生忍住了。

Mind sharing the trial date with us, at least? As we've said, the man's told us nothing, nada, zilch about this predicament.
那个，不能至少跟我们说一声审判什么时候开庭吗？你们也看到了，我们可是一点儿——都没从那家伙嘴里听说过啊。

We would like to know whether there are any requirements for entering the courtroom as observers.
我们也想询问旁听审判是否另有条件。

The proceedings will convene today, in 3 hours.
……审判将在三小时后开庭。

Although the trial won't be open to the public, you may, as close acquaintances of the defendant, be allowed to attend if you apply for seats in the observer gallery now. 虽然这并不是公开审判……不过既然你们似乎与被告关系密切，现在申请旁听应该还是可以入场的。

The observer gallery... I don't assume there is any way for observers to intervene in the proceedings, correct?
只是单纯旁听……也就是说，我们在审判过程中什么都做不了。

Correct, as it is generally the case. I'm... not sure why you would assume otherwise, though my knowledge is limited to trial proceedings at N Corp.
是的，一般来说旁听者能够在审判中做些什么反而是比较罕见的……至少N公司的审判是这样的。

W-wait! What about the jury? Can't we enter as part of the jury...?
那、那……！对了！陪审团制度呢？我们以陪审员的身份出席……

That option is not available.
没有那种制度。

Okay, it's a trial, and at trials, they have... Right, a lawyer. You gotta find a lawyer, don't you? Have you found a lawyer yet, Meursault?
那个……默尔索先生，律师……你找律师了吗？

No, I have not.
没有。

Are you serious? Meursault was with us the whole time. When was he supposed to get a lawyer?!
他一直跟我们待在一起，然后就被抓走了，哪来的时间找律师啊……！

A very frustrated Ishmael yelled at a very flustered Gregor, who still seemed to be reeling from the shock of the news.
面对看起来还很混乱的格里高尔，以实玛利仿佛不耐烦似的喊道。

R-right, right...
也、也对……说得也是……

Then... who's gonna mount a defense for him? Oh, I know—don'tcha people have something like court-appointed lawyers?
那……替他辩护的是谁？就是那种，一开始就给他安排好的律师！

That option is not available.
没有那种制度。

... For this particular trial, the defendant may choose to defend himself in the absence of a lawyer.
……在这场审判中，如果没有另行聘请律师，被告可以自行辩护。

Meursault replied with calm and dry apathy, as though this entire affair didn't involve him at all.
默尔索依旧平淡而冷静，仿佛在说别人的事情。

I believe that's sufficient explanation on the extraordinary circumstances.
看来关于这一特殊情况的说明已经足够充分了。

Wait, we still have—
不，还没……

You'll need to secure a formal negotiation document if you have any remaining queries.
如果还有什么要补充的，请按照程序，在正式取得交涉权后再提出。

The employee cut us off in the indifferent tone of an overworked drone who couldn't be bothered anymore, then began dragging Meursault away.
N公司的员工用疲惫不堪的语气打断了他们的话，带着默尔索离开。

Meursault simply fell into step, surrendered to the momentum of his captors' feet.
默尔索也顺着他们牵引的惯性迈开了脚步。

Halt, good people...! Where be this courthouse in which the trial shall take place?!
等等……各位老爷……！那法院究竟是在何处啊……！

*sigh*
……唉。

Directing a thoroughly put-upon look toward us, the employee answered Don Quixote's question with only a sigh and promptly left.
N公司的员工最后嫌麻烦似的叹了口气，连堂吉诃德的话也没有回答，就径自离开了。

P-prithee, give us an answer at the very least!
至、至少回答一下啊……！

The Collectors in T Corp. were pretty rude, too, but... these people are really something else. It's like they're passive-aggressively trying to let us know that we're being a nuisance to them.
T公司的征收员虽然也谈不上多么亲切……但这里该怎么说呢……感觉已经不只是态度冷淡了，连对我们的厌烦都表现得很明显……

In T Corp., time and wealth are one and the same. One could sense the active desperation not to squander so much as a second.
在T公司，时间与资产本就无法分割，因而有种一刻也不可浪费的迫切。

Here, however... everyone seems to be mired... in ennui.
然而，在此处……每个人似乎都深陷于倦怠之中。

I kept my mouth shut, because I thought it wise to watch how the situation would develop first...
本来我觉得与其贸然插手，不如先在旁边观察发展会比较好，所以才一直没出声……

But now I think anything we could've added afterward would've fallen on deaf ears, if it didn't provoke worse reactions. Those men seemed as uncommitted to their work as the corrupt kleptocrats of S Corp.
不过现在看来，他们还不如那些贪官污吏有干劲，恐怕再费口舌，也只会让事情往更糟的方向发展吧。

Fie, they could have vouchsafed us an answer, at the least...! 'Tis a matter of courtesy...
至少也该给一个答复吧……！这可是礼节问题……

Ugh, forget about 'em, they'll never bother telling us. I know where the courthouse is—here, lemme draw you a map.
哎呀，算了啦！法院在哪我知道，我给你画张地图就是了！

W-wait awhile, Lady Ezra. Let us leave the drawing of the map to the Mentor. Best you direct your attention to—
且、且慢，以斯拉小姐。画地图这种事可以交给头领来做……

As the LCD trio was working on drawing a map on a piece of paper, Rodya stomped up to Faust with barely-disguised anger. There was a cold bite in her voice.
在LCD三人组绘制前往法院的路线图时，罗佳怒气冲冲地走到浮士德面前质问道。

I have a pretty good idea of what your answer's gonna be, but I'm still gonna ask.
我大概能猜得到回答，但即便如此还是要问。

Ya knew this was comin', didn'tcha, Fau? Ya knew about this crap the whole time.
小浮，你早就知道了吧？事情会变成现在这个样子……

Don'tcha think ya could've at least warned us about it?! Ya know perfectly well that Meur's not the type to dump his baggage on anyone!
既然知道的话就该提前告诉我们啊！明明你也知道默尔不是会主动开口说这种事的人……！

Faust taking the initiative would have served no purpose.
即便由浮士德主动告知，也没有意义。

It never has. And it never will.
正如一直以来那样，今后也会如此。

Ya really are... *sigh* forget it.
你……！唉，算了。

A tempest of a sigh tore out of Rodya's lips. She walked away from the subject, as though she had realized that pressing Faust further wouldn't go anywhere.
大概是觉得再追问下去也无济于事，随着一声重重的叹息，罗佳结束了话题。

What's gonna happen to Meursault if... if things don't go well?
……要是审判结果不好的话，默尔索先生会怎么样？

Worry thee not, for I have conceived a plan.
吾已有对策。

... And what plan is that?
……什么对策？

With combined efforts, we shall defeat the armsmen of the courthouse and secure a path inside. While young Ishmael standeth guard, I alone shall most sneakily venture into the dungeons beneath! We need only young Heathcliff to purloin the key from the warden and—
诸位齐心协力击倒巡查的武装卫兵……趁以实玛利负责望风，吾再潜入地下牢房！只要希斯克利夫能从卫兵那里偷偷弄来钥匙……

Did you lift that straight from the comic book you were reading on the bus yesterday?
那个……不是你昨天在巴士上看的漫画内容吗？

... Prison dungeons? In N Corp., huh? Where did you even get that bit from?
还有，N公司有地下牢房这件事，又是哪来的情报？

Eeep...! That's... I do conceive that strongholds are furnished with dungeons, so...
呃……那个……城堡里一般都会有地下牢房之类的……

And this is what I get for indulging my curiosity.
果然我就不该问的。

Bamboo, Aeng-du, start looking for a lawyer who can represent Meursault in court. I'll contact the Team Lead, bring her up to speed, and see if she has any advice for us.
总之……我先去联系一下队长，大叔和樱桃的话，还是去打听一下能不能找到律师比较好。

You fellas'd do that for us? Oh boy, that'd be a great help!
哦，如果可以的话那真是帮大忙了！

... No, that'd be quite troublesome, actually.
……不，那会更麻烦。

Does the LCD team not have a different task that must be completed within the day?
LCD应该还有其他今天之内必须处理的工作吧。

Geh... I mean, yes, we do, but you're in a real pickle now and need all the help you can get if you want out of the pickle jar.
呃……话是这么说没错啦……可毕竟你们现在都已经是这种状况了……

Hmm...? Do they?
嗯……？是吗？

The lady said otherwise, though. Let's head back and get ready for our task.
既然都这么说了，那我们就回去吧。

But...
但是……

Didn't you hear, Aeng-du? "Quite troublesome," she said. I'm not entirely certain of the predicament they face, but it seems that the stones on their board must do without our advice.
樱桃啊，人家不是都说不方便了吗？虽然具体情况我也不清楚，但看来这不是我们该插手的事情。

Is that truly the reason that you wish to withhold our advice, Mentor?
真的是因为这个缘故吗，头领？

Ezra furrowed her brows in consternation at Kim's comment... but eventually, she relented with a sigh. She shook her head in defeat.
听了金笠的话，以斯拉紧紧皱起眉头，陷入了沉思……随即重重叹了口气，摇了摇头。

... Fine. You're sayin' this is LCB's responsibility—okay. Then we'll leave it up to you guys, but be sure to call for us when things go south, got it?
……我懂了，从这里开始就是LCB的工作内容了，对吧？那我们就先走了，不过要是遇到什么麻烦，绝对要联系我们哦。

... We will.
……好，我们会的。

With the LCD leaving us for their own task...
就这样，在LCD离开去处理其他工作之后……

Faust slowly opened her mouth amid the piercing glares from the other Sinners.
在罪人们尖锐的视线中，浮士德镇定地开口了。

Faust is not without a plan.
……浮士德有一个计划。

Sure you aren't. Would be nice if you let us in on it for a change.
还是一个我们完全不知道的计划。

*sigh* But you can't, because of that clause in our contract that says you're forbidden from going out of your way to tell the rest of us about a Sinner's past, right? 唉……这次也是因为那条规定吗？浮士德小姐不能主动说出罪人们过去的事情。

Yes. That seems to be the case.
嗯，大概就是这样。

Why did you reject the LCD's offer of assistance?
拒绝LCD协助的理由是什么？

For lack of any meaningful help they could provide, given the nature of this trial. Faust's analysis concludes their presence in the courtroom will only prove to be a deterrent to our mission.
因为这场审判的特殊性，他们无法提供实质性的帮助。在浮士德看来，他们反而更有可能成为阻碍。

<Fine. So just what exactly are you plannin—>
<那么你的计划是……>

... The present time constraints will not permit us the luxury of holding a briefing session.
……现在没有说明的时间了。

A mere 3 hours remain until the trial doth convene... Ah, verily, we are in a race against time.
既然说是三小时后……呜，时间着实所剩无几了。

First... Let us head to the courthouse. The plan will become clear soon after our arrival...
首先……我们先去法院。至于计划，就算不进行说明……

... without requiring any elaboration.
到了法庭上，你们也应该马上就能明白了。
